## What is coding

Text data such as interview transcrips and research papers consist of a bunch of statements. Coding is a process of assigning themes to parts of these texts to be able to make sense of them and summarize them into a manageable representation. Consider the following part of interview transcript, with the relevant parts that I have highlighted. In this case, let's find out "what are the opportunities and challenges experienced by senior teachers in using technology for teaching."

Teacher A: <br>
I found it difficult to improve my teaching skills because <mark style = "background-color: green">professional development is offered more frequently in cities</mark>, and we do not have access to funding to participate in this program because we teach in a rural school. <mark style = "background-color: orange">Our school is very very far from cities</mark>. Sometimes, <mark style = "background-color: yellow">I tried to learn how to use technology such as Quizizz from YouTube videos</mark>. <mark style = "background-color: yellow">I was very interested to try that in my class</mark>, but <mark style = "background-color: pink">there is no projector in my school</mark>, and <mark style = "background-color: pink">students are not allowed to bring their own smartphone</mark> because the school does not want students to play games or access prohibited websites in schools. <mark style = "background-color: pink">Some of the students even do not have any smartphone</mark>. 

Teacher B:<br>
For me, I like to do everything perfect, which according to my fellow teachers makes me too busy everyday. I agree with them and in fact I do not have time to participate in any professional development. <mark style = "background-color: green">There was a very important two-week training on using technology in teaching English in one of the schools around my area</mark>. I heard this training was administered by lecturers from Universitas Syiah Kuala as a part of their community services responsibility. But, I was so busy marking my students' exam very very carefully that <mark style = "background-color: orange">I did not have time to participate in this training</mark>. As you may guess, I very rarely use technology in teaching because <mark style = "background-color: plum">it makes everything so complicated</mark>. I would have to prepare the materials based on this technology, I have to ensure that students have devices to use this technology, <mark style = "background-color: DarkCyan">the electricity is sometimes off<mark>, <mark style = "background-color: Turquoise">the internet connection is too slow</mark>, and many more challenges. <mark style = "background-color: yellow">I understand that my students will be more motivated if I use technology</mark>, as what other teachers have shared.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A(Opportunities)
  A --> B(Teacher positive perception)
  B --> C[I was very interested to try that in my class]
  B --> D[I understand that my students will be more motivated if I use technology]
  A --> E(Professional development opportunity)
  E --> F["professional development is offered more frequently in cities"]
  E --> G["there was a very important two-week training on using technology in teaching English in one of the schools around my area"]
  A --> H(Independent learning)
  H --> I["I tried to learn how to use technology such as Quizizz from YouTube videos"]
```

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A(Challenges)
  A --> B(Professional development)
  B --> C(Distance)
  C --> D["Our school is very very far from cities"]
  B --> E(lack of time)
  E --> F["I did not have time to participate in this training"]
  A --> G("Lack of technology devices")
  G --> H["there is no projector in my school"]
  G --> I["students are not allowed to bring their own smartphone"]
  G --> J["Some of the students even do not have any smartphone"]
  A --> K(Teacher negative perception)
  K --> L["it makes everything so complicated"]
  A --> M(Electricity problem)
  M --> N["the electricity is sometimes off"]
  A --> O(Unreliable internet)
  O --> P["the internet connection is too slow"]
  
```
